_source: Published parameter sets for the indirect forcing of CO, VOC, H2 and NOx; generated by dev/build_ar6_data.py, do not edit by hand. steady_state_forcing: W m-2 per (kg yr-1) of the 'basis' species (= AGWP at infinite horizon of a 1 kg pulse); response_time and precursor_lifetime in yr. 'published' holds the source's GWPs, used as test references only, with the CO2 AGWP the source used. status: literature | literature-mean | fallback (a value from another source, see the *_source fields).

mass_basis._source: kg of basis species per kg of flow; VOC -> C: carbon fraction of the Fuglestvedt et al. 2010 (Section 7.3) VOC mixture
